title: POENA DAMNI, the pain of loss
html_source:
Notice how this part was translated by the preacher in his speech, which is somewhat unusual so far in the book.

Because this is directly translated, it makes it more accessible for those he is addressing, like the preacher wants it to be more understandable—he seems to care that his speech is understood.
